short: The total value of what you sold before any costs.
metaDescription: Revenue is the total value of goods and services sold in a period, before any costs are deducted. The total value of what you sold before any costs.
definition: Revenue is the total value of goods and services sold in a period, before any costs are deducted. It is also called turnover or top line, and in GST terms it maps to your outward supplies.
bodyHtml:
Why Revenue matters

Revenue is the headline number everyone quotes and the least informative one on its own. Growing revenue with falling margin is a common and expensive way to get busier without earning more.

Revenue formula

Net revenue = Gross sales − Returns − Discounts

Excludes GST collected, which is not income but tax held on the government's behalf.

How Revenue works in practice

Read revenue net of returns and discounts, and separate it by channel — dine-in, delivery, wholesale — because each has its own cost structure. Revenue also sets GST registration and filing thresholds.

faq.question: Does revenue include GST?
faq.answer: No. Tax collected is a liability, not income, so revenue is measured net of it.

faq.question: Is revenue the same as cash received?
faq.answer: Not under accrual accounting. Credit sales are revenue when billed, whatever date the money arrives.
